items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Blanton was a great influence on me.

ctx.x: All right. The -- I know a little bit about some of the people who had an influence on you. But I just wonder if you could say again as to who they were and what they meant to you.

Jimmy Blanton was a great influence on me. I tried to learn what he did, but I knew it was complicated because nobody's played those type of intervals in jazz that I know of. As far as I'm concerned, (inaudible). So I tried to play the things he played, like Georgia Brown, "Jack the Bear," "Sophisticated Lady," "Jumpin' Pumpkin," (singing), what's that for blues -- blues, something. (Singing.) And Duke Ellington. He (inaudible) do that solo together "Jack the Bear"? Did I say Jackie Brown? "Jack the Bear," but…
I think you may have said Jackie Brown, but say it again.
